chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahzīyār, from Faḍālah, from Abān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who prays while there is excrement on his garment from a human, a cat, or a dog: should he repeat his salat (prayer)? He said: If he did not know, then he does not repeat.

key_terms.لَمْ يَعْلَمْ: he did not know; he was unaware

ai.seo_question: Does someone need to repeat salat (prayer) if they prayed without knowing their clothing had najasah on it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about salat (prayer) performed in a garment contaminated with najasah. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that if the person was unaware of the impurity at the time of prayer, he does not have to repeat the prayer.
